title: Windows 11 Cumulative Security Update August 2024
summary: Critical vulnerability in the Windows TCP/IP IPv6 network stack (tcpip.sys) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via specially crafted IPv6 packets.

title: Windows 11 Security Update July 2024
summary: Remote Code Execution vulnerability in the Windows Remote Desktop Licensing Service (lserver.exe) with SYSTEM privileges without prior authentication.

title: Out-of-band security update for Windows Print Spooler (PrintNightmare)
summary: Remote code execution vulnerability in spoolsv.exe allowing attackers to install malicious print drivers and gain SYSTEM privileges via PointAndPrint.

title: Windows 11 Security Update June 2022 (Follina MSDT)
summary: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution vulnerability when called using URI protocol handlers from malicious Office documents.

title: Windows 10 & 11 Security Update August 2021 (Netlogon & Spooler)
summary: Elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows Print Spooler service and Netlogon RPC client encryption validation.

title: Windows Security Update February 2023 (SMB & CLFS)
summary: Windows Graphics Component and Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Elevation of Privilege vulnerability exploited in the wild.
